title: 2028 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2028 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid is an all-new version of the affordable hybrid-powered sedan with futuristic styling and the brand's latest high-tech infotainment system.
body_markdown:
The hybrid version of Hyundai’s long-running compact sedan gets a styling and technology upgrade, while maintaining great fuel economy.


## 2028 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date

## What’s New for the 2028 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid


For 2028, the Elantra Hybrid switches to the next-generation Elantra platform that **[debuted with non-hybrid models for 2027](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-hyundai-elantra-pricing-specs-release-date)** . Production schedules have pushed the hybrid to the following model year, but it receives the same upgrades, including new styling and infotainment tech. The powertrain doesn’t see as many upgrades, but the Elantra Hybrid was already competitive in that area.


## Design


The Elantra Hybrid is styled identically to non-hybrid models, and it’s hard to believe that either is a Hyundai Elantra. The previous generation of this compact sedan (in which the hybrid debuted) wasn’t exactly boring, but this generation takes things in a completely different direction. The combination of bold fenders and sharp edges is something we haven’t seen before on a compact sedan, including the previous Elantra. Everything is tied together by what Hyundai calls “H-Edge” lighting, linear elements inspired by the accent lighting on buildings. It all comes together to make the Elantra Hybrid look like anything but an economy car.


## Powertrain


Unlike the styling, the powertrain is very familiar. The 2028 Elantra Hybrid is powered by a 1.6-liter four-cylinder engine connected to a six-speed dual-clutch transmission with an integrated electric motor, just like the outgoing version. As before, only front-wheel drive (FWD) is available. However, total system output is due to rise appreciably, from 139 horsepower to 155 hp. Hyundai was still certifying the 2028 model with the EPA at the time of writing, so it’s unclear if it will improve on the current Elantra Hybrid’s 54 mpg combined fuel-economy figure, which is extremely strong. The Elantra Hybrid also gains a couple of notable new features for 2028. A “smart” regenerative braking system is designed to maximize both energy recovery under deceleration and the battery pack’s lifespan. Stay mode keeps the climate control, audio system, and lighting running while parked for as long as possible without turning on the engine.


## Interior


The cabin's makeover is nearly as dramatic as the exterior's, with rounded surfaces and a prominent infotainment touchscreen. Available ambient lighting helps to make the most of these design elements, which Hyundai says are meant to recall furniture more than typical car interior parts. Like non-hybrid models, the 2028 Elantra Hybrid is 3.3 inches longer, 1.1 inches wider, and 0.3 inches taller than the outgoing model, with a wheelbase that’s 1.1 inches longer. That translates into some additional interior space compared with the previous generation, including an extra 1.1 inches of rear-seat legroom and an additional 0.7 inches of headroom in both rows, according to Hyundai. Buyers can expect the hybrid version to have slightly less than the 13.9 cubic feet of trunk space available in the **[2027 Elantra](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-hyundai-elantra-pricing-specs-release-date)** (due to the placement of the battery pack), itself a bit less than previous-generation Elantra models. The hybrid has the same small-item storage space as other Elantra models, including available dual wireless device chargers.


## Technology


The 2028 Elantra Hybrid comes standard with the same 9.9-inch digital instrument cluster and 12.9-inch touchscreen that non-hybrid Elantra models got for 2027. All Elantra models now feature Hyundai’s new Pleos Connect infotainment system and associated Gleo AI-based voice assistant, as well as wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. Along with the new infotainment system comes a new layout meant to minimize distraction. Only the most vital information is displayed in the instrument cluster, while everything else has been shifted to the generously sized touchscreen. That screen’s main menu also keeps functions the driver might need to use closer to the left side for easier access, and there are still plenty of analog controls. As with the non-hybrid Elantra, digital key technology and a Bang & Olufsen audio system will be available.

## Safety


The 2028 Elantra Hybrid will offer expected driver-assistance features such as forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-keep assist, high-beam assist, and a driver-attention monitor. Like other current Hyundai models, the 2028 Elantra Hybrid will also be available with remote smart parking assist, parking sensors, a surround-view camera system, and blind-spot cameras. Safety ratings from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) and National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) weren’t available at the time of writing. The outgoing Elantra Hybrid received a five-star overall safety rating from the NHTSA, and the Elantra lineup as a whole received an IIHS 2026 Top Safety Pick award, setting a high bar for the new Elantra Hybrid.


## Pricing and Release Date


Pricing for the 2028 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid was not available at the time of writing. For reference, the 2026 Elantra Hybrid started at $26,945 with the mandatory $1,295 destination charge. The Elantra Hybrid skips the 2027 model year due to production timing that sees it shuffled behind non-hybrid versions of the redesigned Elantra, but it could still arrive before the end of the 2027 calendar year.
